method: Separate 1ms CPU diagnostics, 50 committed moves before capture, then 9 moves and 9 Undo. Snapshot and validation unchanged. selectedFunctions retains matching functions even outside top 30. Inclusive rows overlap; do not sum. Not input latency.

metadata.method: Separate CPU diagnostic with source maps; includes browser/driver idle and coordination. Not an input-latency benchmark.

move.method: Sample-weighted microseconds, including idle/driver work. Inclusive paths overlap; do not sum. Source positions are function starts, not individual hot statements. Sampling is not exact function timing.

undo.method: Sample-weighted microseconds, including idle/driver work. Inclusive paths overlap; do not sum. Source positions are function starts, not individual hot statements. Sampling is not exact function timing.
